# Overview

This notebook implements the following workflow, split into self-contained sections that can be run independently:

1. Load data (clinical + MAF via **maftools**)
2. Align clinical and mutation cohorts
3. Define **MSI vs MSS** by **MSIsensor** cutoff (20)
4. Remove hypermutators within MSS by **TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS < 10**
5. Build MAF subsets (MSI, MSS, MSS regular-mutation-load)
6. Identify **RAS-mutant** vs **RAS-WT** within MSS regular-load
7. Plot oncoplots
8. Save outputs (MAF objects + sample ID lists)

> Set file paths and toggles under `params` in the YAML header above (or via **Knit > Knit with Parameters...**).

---

```{r}
# Clinical reader: skip ALL leading '#' metadata; first non-# line is the header
read_clinical_cbioportal <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  first_header <- which(!grepl("^\\s*#", lines))[1]
  if (is.na(first_header)) stop("No header found in clinical file (only '#' lines?).")
  data.table::fread(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, skip = first_header - 1, data.table = FALSE)
}

# Back-compat generic reader (used by older chunks)
read_any_table <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  if (ext %in% c("tsv","txt")) data.table::fread(path, sep = "\t", data.table = FALSE)
  else if (ext == "csv")       data.table::fread(path, sep = ",", data.table = FALSE)
  else                         data.table::fread(path, sep = "\t", data.table = FALSE)
}

# Pick a column name (case/underscore-insensitive)
pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  nms <- tolower(gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "_", names(df)))
  for (cand in candidates) {
    pat <- tolower(gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "_", cand))
    hit <- which(nms == pat)
    if (length(hit) == 1) return(names(df)[hit])
  }
  for (cand in candidates) {
    pat <- tolower(gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "_", cand))
    hit <- which(startsWith(nms, pat))
    if (length(hit) == 1) return(names(df)[hit])
  }
  stop(sprintf("Could not find a column among candidates: %s", paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")))
}

patient_from_barcode <- function(x) substr(x, 1, 12)

# --- Writer that outputs clean character lines (drops NA/empty values) ---
safe_write <- function(x, path) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    warning("Nothing to write for: ", path, " (object is NULL)")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (is.data.frame(x) || is.matrix(x)) x <- unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  if (!length(x)) {
    warning("Nothing to write for: ", path, " (zero-length after cleanup)")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  writeLines(x, con = path)
}

```

```{r}
#Load data 
message("Reading clinical: ", params$clinical_path)
cbioportal_clinical <- read_any_table(params$clinical_path)

cbioportal_clinical <- cbioportal_clinical[-c(1:4),]
dim(cbioportal_clinical)

message("Reading MAF: ", params$maf_path)
cbioportal_maf <- maftools::read.maf(maf = params$maf_path, verbose = FALSE)

# Peek
dplyr::glimpse(cbioportal_clinical)
cbioportal_maf


```

```{r}
#Align Clinical and Mutation Cohorts
# clinical file uses "Sample Identifier"
sample_col <- pick_col(
  cbioportal_clinical,
  c("Sample Identifier","SAMPLE_ID","SAMPLE","Tumor_Sample_Barcode")
)

tsb_maf <- unique(cbioportal_maf@data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

cbioportal_clinical <- cbioportal_clinical %>%
  mutate(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED = .data[[sample_col]]) %>%
  filter(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED %in% tsb_maf)

# Sanity: one sample per patient (first 12 chars)
pat_counts <- cbioportal_clinical %>%
  transmute(patient = patient_from_barcode(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED)) %>%
  count(patient, name = "n_samples")

multi_map <- pat_counts %>% filter(n_samples > 1)

if (nrow(multi_map) > 0) {
  warning("Some patients have multiple aligned samples. Review:\n")
  print(multi_map)
} else {
  message("Sanity check passed: one sample per patient.")
}

cat("Aligned clinical n=", nrow(cbioportal_clinical), "\n")
cat("MAF unique TSB n=", length(tsb_maf), "\n")


```

```{r}
#Define MSI vs MSS (MSIsensor cutoff 20)

# clinical file uses "MSIsensor Score" (and sometimes "MSI MANTIS Score")
msi_col <- pick_col(
  cbioportal_clinical,
  c("MSIsensor Score","MSI_SENSOR_SCORE","MSI MANTIS Score","MSI_SCORE","MSISENSOR_SCORE")
)

cbioportal_clinical[[msi_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cbioportal_clinical[[msi_col]]))

tcga_mss_samples <- cbioportal_clinical %>%
  filter(.data[[msi_col]] < 20) %>%
  pull(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED) %>% unique()

tcga_msi_samples <- cbioportal_clinical %>%
  filter(.data[[msi_col]] >= 20) %>%
  pull(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED) %>% unique()

cbioportal_clinical_mss <- cbioportal_clinical %>%
  filter(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED %in% tcga_mss_samples)

cat("MSS samples:", length(tcga_mss_samples), "\n")
cat("MSI samples:", length(tcga_msi_samples), "\n")

```


```{r}
#Remove Hypermutators within MSS (TMB < 10)
# clinical file uses "TMB (nonsynonymous)"
tmb_col <- pick_col(
  cbioportal_clinical_mss,
  c("TMB (nonsynonymous)","TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS","TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS_PER_MB","TMB_NONSYN","TMB")
)

cbioportal_clinical_mss[[tmb_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cbioportal_clinical_mss[[tmb_col]]))

tcga_mss_rmh_samples <- cbioportal_clinical_mss %>%
  filter(.data[[tmb_col]] < 10) %>%
  pull(SAMPLE_ID_ALIGNED) %>% unique()

cat("MSS (regular mutation load) samples:", length(tcga_mss_rmh_samples), "\n")

```

```{r}
#Build MAF Subsets
cbioportal_maf_msi      <- maftools::subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf,     tsb = tcga_msi_samples,     mafObj = TRUE)
cbioportal_maf_mss      <- maftools::subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf,     tsb = tcga_mss_samples,     mafObj = TRUE)
cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh  <- maftools::subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf,     tsb = tcga_mss_rmh_samples, mafObj = TRUE)

cbioportal_maf_msi
cbioportal_maf_mss
cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh

```
```{r}
#Identify RAS-mutant vs RAS-WT within MSS Regular-load
tmpmaf <- maftools::subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh, genes = c("NRAS","KRAS"), mafObj = TRUE)
tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples <- unique(tmpmaf@data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras <- maftools::subsetMaf(
  cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh,
  tsb = tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples,
  mafObj = TRUE
)

tcga_mss_rmh_raswt_samples <- setdiff(tcga_mss_rmh_samples, tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples)

cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt <- maftools::subsetMaf(
  cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh,
  tsb = tcga_mss_rmh_raswt_samples,
  mafObj = TRUE
)

cat("RAS-mutant MSS-RMH samples:", length(tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples), "\n")
cat("RAS-WT MSS-RMH samples:", length(tcga_mss_rmh_raswt_samples), "\n")

```

```{r save, eval=params$run_save}


### save files

# --- Ensure we have the vectors even if earlier chunks were skipped ---
# MSS regular-load exact TSBs
if (!exists("tsb_mss_rmh")) {
  tsb_mss_rmh <- unique(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh@data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
}

# RAS-mutant and RAS-WT exact TSBs
if (!exists("ras_tsb")) {
  tmpmaf <- maftools::subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh, genes = c("NRAS","KRAS"), mafObj = TRUE)
  ras_tsb <- unique(tmpmaf@data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
}
if (!exists("raswt_tsb")) {
  raswt_tsb <- setdiff(tsb_mss_rmh, ras_tsb)
}

# --- Save MAF objects as before ---
save(
  cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh,
  cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt,
  cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras,
  cbioportal_maf_msi,
  file = sprintf("%s_maf_subsets.RData", params$out_prefix)
)

# --- REQUIRED: two separate text files of TCGA barcodes (exact TSBs) ---
ras_mut_file <- sprintf("%s_RAS_mutant_MSS_TCGA_barcodes.txt", params$out_prefix)
ras_wt_file  <- sprintf("%s_RAS_wildtype_MSS_TCGA_barcodes.txt", params$out_prefix)
safe_write(ras_tsb,   ras_mut_file)
safe_write(raswt_tsb, ras_wt_file)


cat("Saved files:\n",
    "- MAF subsets RData: ", sprintf("%s_maf_subsets.RData", params$out_prefix), "\n",
    "- RAS-mutant TCGA barcodes: ", ras_mut_file, "\n",
    "- RAS-wildtype TCGA barcodes: ", ras_wt_file, "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
#Read in the CGC file
cgc <- read.table(
  "Fig1ABC_CGC_20220314.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  quote = "",
  comment.char = ""
)
```

```{r}
## 1) Gene frequencies across ALL MSS (RASmut + RASWT)
gene_summary_mss <- maftools::getGeneSummary(cbioportal_maf_mss)

## 2) Keep CGC genes, but make sure NRAS is always considered
##    (in case of naming quirks or if it wouldn't otherwise make the top-20)
candidate_genes <- union(cgc$Gene.Symbol, "NRAS")
ranked_mss <- gene_summary_mss %>%
  dplyr::filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% candidate_genes) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(AlteredSamples))

## 3) Build the final 20-gene list with NRAS guaranteed
if ("NRAS" %in% head(ranked_mss$Hugo_Symbol, 20)) {
  top20_tbl <- dplyr::slice_head(ranked_mss, n = 20)
} else {
  # take top 19 excluding NRAS, then add NRAS, then re-order by frequency
  top19_ex_nras <- ranked_mss %>%
    dplyr::filter(Hugo_Symbol != "NRAS") %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 19)
  nras_row <- ranked_mss %>% dplyr::filter(Hugo_Symbol == "NRAS")
  top20_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(top19_ex_nras, nras_row) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(AlteredSamples))
}

top20_genes_mss <- top20_tbl$Hugo_Symbol

## (Optional) sanity check
message("Top 20 MSS genes used (NRAS forced-in if needed):")
print(top20_genes_mss)

```

```{r}
#Make the Oncoplot
#NBEA - 5%, KMT2C - 4%
#Oncoplot for RAS-mutant MSS samples
maftools::oncoplot(
  maf = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras,
  genes = top20_genes_mss,
  sortByMutation = TRUE,       # order samples by mutation load
  sortByAnnotation = FALSE, # keep gene order as supplied
  writeMatrix = TRUE  
)
```

```{r}
#MSS RAS wiltype - same set of genes from RAS mt
maftools::oncoplot(
  maf = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt,
  genes = top20_genes_mss,
  sortByMutation = TRUE,
  sortByAnnotation = FALSE,
  writeMatrix = TRUE 
)
```

```{r}
#pathway for RAS mutant samples 
pws = pathways(maf = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras, plotType = 'treemap')
plotPathways(maf = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras, pathlist = pws)
```

